name: reqif.saveMapping
title: Save ReqIF mapping
summary: Save or change the mapping of a source to the own metamodel, in the mapping folder (default `reqif`).
whileReadOnlyReason: Maps a source to the own metamodel, which is missing or faulty.

mapping.description: The whole mapping, without `source-model`, which only reqif.import writes: an existing file keeps its own, unless `file` names the file of another source, whose source model is then removed.

file.description: Inside the mapping folder of the workspace, for every access; default the portable source name.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
